top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at Istria Granfondo. Practice on coastal flats exploding into brutal Istrian hills: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 65 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Istria Granfondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
88ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Istria Granfondo, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
5,725ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
65 miles on coastal flats exploding into brutal Istrian hills burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Istria Granfondo. Train it until it feels boring.
5,725ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Istria Granfondo. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on coastal flats exploding into brutal Istrian hills can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Low-cadence force work supports 5,725ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
Base fitness for Istria Granfondo. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Istria Granfondo's 65 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Istria Granfondo. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Istria Granfondo rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on coastal flats exploding into brutal istrian hills to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 65 miles of coastal flats exploding into brutal istrian hills in Umag, Istria County, Croatia.
